Each accepted conversion cause takes its suffix and tail accumulator as PROJECTIONS of total_forest_outcome_cause — the cause read off the retained outcomes_trace — so no foreign pair satisfies the statement; it carries the exact ConversionStep, operand SuffixMember and prior outcome, tail-to-final preservation, index navigation, the ONE convert_constant, and the exact current ExpressionFact.

Occurrence identity survives into the returned value: the retained members sit at pairwise DISTINCT keys, and two occurrences of a syntactically EQUAL expression are distinct members at distinct keys.

One rejected root theorem returns one exact fail from one exact rejected compile branch, and THAT SAME fail carries the whole rejected guarantee. Failure is indexed by its program, so no transport is involved.

The rejected side pins the phase, RAW and FINAL diagnostic lists to the EXACT singleton InvalidConversion reason — exact code and exact retained source references — never a length, a non-emptiness, or an exists-reason.
